pages.text: Give the spring blank its turn in the blast furnace. The finished spring is the dark, curved piece shown here. One serves the trigger assembly of either firearm; reserve it for that work.
One finished Tempered Mainspring. Keep this piece ready for the next assembly.
Place one of these blanks in a blast furnace with fuel. The result is one Tempered Mainspring. Time: 15 seconds at 20 TPS. An ordinary furnace will not perform this recipe.
